speaker: consultant
text: Good afternoon, Elena Ward.

speaker: customer
text: Hello, my name is Mark Daniels. I found your website and I have some questions about how your process works.

speaker: consultant
text: Of course, Mark. What would you like to know?

speaker: customer
text: I have never worked with a consultant before. What actually happens after the first call?

speaker: consultant
text: It starts with a free discovery call, about twenty minutes. We talk about your business and whether I am the right person to help. There is no commitment.

speaker: customer
text: And if we decide to work together?

speaker: consultant
text: Then I send you an intake questionnaire within twenty-four hours. It asks about your goals, your numbers, and what you have already tried.

speaker: customer
text: How long does the questionnaire take?

speaker: consultant
text: Most people finish it in about thirty minutes. The more honest you are, the more useful our first session will be.

speaker: customer
text: Makes sense. What comes next?

speaker: consultant
text: The kickoff session, which happens within ten days of signing. After the kickoff, I write an action plan and send it to you within five business days.

speaker: customer
text: Are the sessions in person or online?

speaker: consultant
text: Mostly online by video, but I can meet in person if you are in the city.

speaker: customer
text: I run a small landscaping company, so my schedule is a bit unpredictable. What are your working hours?

speaker: consultant
text: Monday to Friday, nine in the morning until six in the evening. If you need to move a session, it is free as long as you tell me at least forty-eight hours before.

speaker: customer
text: That is good to know. I am not ready to sign anything yet, I am just collecting information.

speaker: consultant
text: That is completely fine. Would you like me to email you a short overview of the process and the prices?

speaker: customer
text: Yes, please. My email is mark dot daniels at example dot com.

speaker: consultant
text: Got it. And is there a phone number where I can reach you?

speaker: customer
text: Sure, it is five five five, zero one four two.

speaker: consultant
text: Thank you, Mark. I will send the overview today, and you can book the free discovery call whenever you are ready.

speaker: customer
text: Great, thanks for explaining everything so clearly.
